title: AlloyDB: `edition` deprecated, `Backup.expressConfig` now output-only
summary: The `edition` field on both `Backup` and `Cluster` resources is now deprecated, with a recommendation to use the `ExpressConfig` property instead. Additionally, the `expressConfig` property on `Backup` has been made read-only, which is a breaking change if you were previously setting it.
details:
Developers should update their code to stop using the `edition` field on both `Backup` and `Cluster` resources, as it is now deprecated. For configuring cluster editions, refer to the `ExpressConfig` property on the `Cluster` resource instead. This deprecation applies to all enum values of the `edition` field.

**Breaking Change:** The `expressConfig` property within the `Backup` schema has been made read-only. If your applications were previously attempting to set this property during backup creation or modification, those operations will now fail. This field is now strictly output-only, reflecting the Express configuration of the source cluster.
